description: This file contains native C++ code implementing a JNI interface for a binary dictionary used in an Android keyboard application. It includes functions for opening, querying, validating, and closing a dictionary, as well as JNI registration routines.

methods.name: throwException
methods.description: Helper function to throw a Java exception from native code.

methods.name: nativeime_BinaryDictionary_open
methods.description: Opens a binary dictionary from a file descriptor, reading its contents into memory and creating a Dictionary object.

methods.name: nativeime_BinaryDictionary_getSuggestions
methods.description: Retrieves suggestions from the dictionary based on input codes.

methods.name: nativeime_BinaryDictionary_isValidWord
methods.description: Checks if a given word (as char array) is valid in the dictionary.

methods.name: nativeime_BinaryDictionary_close
methods.description: Closes and deletes the Dictionary object, freeing resources.

methods.name: registerNativeMethods
methods.description: Registers native methods with JNI for a specific class.

methods.name: registerNatives
methods.description: Performs registration of native methods for the BinaryDictionary JNI class.

methods.name: JNI_OnLoad
methods.description: JNI entry point called when the native library is loaded, responsible for registering native methods.
